1.w: A psalm of David, written to get God’s attention. O Lord , do not continue to rebuke me in your anger. Do not continue to punish me in your raging fury.

2.w: For your arrows pierce me, and your hand presses me down.

3.w: My whole body is sick because of your judgment; I am deprived of health because of my sin.

4.w: For my sins overwhelm me; like a heavy load, they are too much for me to bear.

5.w: My wounds are infected and starting to smell, because of my foolish sins.

6.w: I am dazed and completely humiliated; all day long I walk around mourning.

7.w: For I am overcome with shame, and my whole body is sick.

8.w: I am numb with pain and severely battered; I groan loudly because of the anxiety I feel.

9.w: O Lord, you understand my heart’s desire; my groaning is not hidden from you.

10.w: My heart beats quickly; my strength leaves me. I can hardly see.

11.w: Because of my condition, even my friends and acquaintances keep their distance; my neighbors stand far away.

12.w: Those who seek my life try to entrap me; those who want to harm me speak destructive words. All day long they say deceitful things.

13.w: But I am like a deaf man—I hear nothing; I am like a mute who cannot speak.

14.w: I am like a man who cannot hear and is incapable of arguing his defense.

15.w: Yet I wait for you, O Lord ! You will respond, O Lord, my God!

16.w: I have prayed for deliverance, because otherwise they will gloat over me; when my foot slips they will arrogantly taunt me.

17.w: For I am about to stumble, and I am in constant pain.

18.w: Yes, I confess my wrongdoing, and I am concerned about my sins.

19.w: But those who are my enemies for no reason are numerous; those who hate me without cause outnumber me.

20.w: They repay me evil for the good I have done; though I have tried to do good to them, they hurl accusations at me.

21.w: Do not abandon me, O Lord . My God, do not remain far away from me.

22.w: Hurry and help me, O Lord, my deliverer.
